# PMTiles JavaScript 4.5.0

Official browser distribution from https://registry.npmjs.org/pmtiles/-/pmtiles-4.5.0.tgz (`dist/pmtiles.js`). Vendored unmodified for offline raster PMTiles reading by local HTTP Range requests. BSD-3-Clause reference implementation license included in LICENSE, obtained from https://github.com/protomaps/PMTiles/blob/main/LICENSE because the npm archive omits it.

Documentation: https://docs.protomaps.com/pmtiles/leaflet and https://github.com/protomaps/PMTiles

Data archives carry their own attribution and licensing. The vector renderer contains its own PMTiles reader; this bundle provides the independent raster reader.
